name: CoCounsel Legal
description:
CoCounsel Legal delivers fiduciary-grade agentic AI, built on the authority of Westlaw and the guidance of Practical Law. 

To use the CoCounsel Legal connector, you need a CoCounsel Legal license, to have switched to the next generation of CoCounsel, and a Thomson Reuters Account.

The connector is offered as a pilot and may be modified, suspended, or withdrawn at any time, in whole or in part, without notice.
Connector use is governed by your organization’s agreement with Thomson Reuters for CoCounsel Legal (”Agreement”), and the terms on this page (“Usage Terms”). Thomson Reuters content, and any output containing it, that you access through the connector remains Thomson Reuters content and stays subject to the Agreement and Usage Terms; connecting through the connector does not give you any additional rights to Thomson Reuters content it, and you may use it only for your organization’s ordinary internal business purposes.
You must not, whether directly or through any tool, agent, model, or interface (including a model context protocol (MCP) connection): (i) provide or make Thomson Reuters content available to another Professional AI Tool (meaning a third-party application or service whose primary purpose is to perform legal, audit, tax, compliance, or accounting research, analysis, drafting, summarization, automation, or similar tasks using artificial intelligence); or (ii) use Thomson Reuters content to train, fine-tune, or improve any AI or machine-learning model, or as a knowledge base, index, embeddings store, or retrieval or inference source for any AI system (including for retrieval-augmented generation). 
You are responsible for configuring your connected environment so that Thomson Reuters content is not routed or exposed to any such tool, including by not relying on any “always allow” or “auto-approve” setting that would permit it.

By installing, enabling, or using the connector, you accept these terms for your organization; if not, do not use it.

_published_faq.name: How do I add CoCounsel Legal to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add CoCounsel Legal to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://cocoagent-service.cocounsel.thomsonreuters.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the CoCounsel Legal MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: CoCounsel Legal provides these MCP tools: start_cocounsel_chat, ask_cocounsel, upload_file, list_cocounsel_files, and get_cocounsel_output.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to CoCounsel Legal?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to CoCounsel Legal in search-research on the Manufact MCP catalog include Agentic Atlas: Agent Design Patterns, common-practice, GDELT Cloud, BookDNA, and Lyon.

_published_faq.name: Does CoCounsel Legal MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: CoCounsel Legal requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
CoCounsel Legal is developed by Thomson Reuters. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
